sanskrit: ājyād ajaḥ sam abhavad deśebhya odanā ime | tān apaśyad bṛhaspatiḥ sa vai pañcaudano 'bhavat ||
english: From clarified butter the goat came into being; from the quarters these rice-porridges arose. Bṛhaspati beheld them — he it was who became the five-porridge sacrifice.

sanskrit: caturdhaitāṃ sam abhara odanāṃs tvaṃ bṛhaspate | aja ājyāj jātaḥ sa eṣāṃ pañcamo 'bhavat ||
english: Gather these porridges together in fourfold fashion, O Bṛhaspati. The goat, born from clarified butter, became the fifth among them.

sanskrit: dhūmena divam āpnoty antarikṣam utoṣmaṇā | diśa āpnoti cakṣuṣā ajaḥ pañcaudanaḥ savaḥ ||
english: By its smoke it reaches heaven; by its heat it reaches the atmosphere; by its glow it reaches the quarters — this goat, the five-porridge sacrifice.

sanskrit: yā te mātā yas te pitā bhrātaro ye ca te svāḥ | ajaṃ pañcaudanaṃ paktvā sarve tam upa jīvata ||
english: Your mother, your father, your brothers, and those who are your own — let them all live upon it, having cooked the goat as the five-porridge offering.

sanskrit: ye te pūrve parāgatā apare pitaraś ca ye | tebhyo ghṛtasya kulyaitu śatadhārā vyundatī ||
english: Those of your forebears who have gone beyond, and those who are the more recent fathers — let a stream of clarified butter flow to them, hundredfold, flooding everywhere.

sanskrit: ye sarvadā dadati ye vā pacanty odanam | te vai yamasya rājyād uttare loka āsate ||
english: Those who always give, or those who cook the rice-porridge — they indeed dwell in a world higher than the realm of Yama.

sanskrit: nātirātra āpnoti nainam āpnoty ukthyaḥ | nāgniṣṭoma āpnoty ajaṃ pañcaudanaṃ savam ||
english: The Atirātra does not attain it; the Ukthya does not attain it; nor does the Agniṣṭoma attain the goat, the five-porridge sacrifice.

sanskrit: daśarātreṇa saṃmito dvādaśāhena kalpate | dīrghasattreṇa saṃmito 'jaḥ pañcaudanaḥ savaḥ ||
english: It is measured equal to the Daśarātra; it is reckoned equivalent to the Dvādaśāha; the goat, the five-porridge sacrifice, is measured equal to the Dīrghasattra.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ barhiṣyaṃ sarvaṃ yan naṣṭaṃ yac ca mriyate | yac ca steno 'pājati yeṣāṃ pañcaudanaḥ savaḥ ||
english: All that is lost from the sacrificial grass, all that perishes, all that a thief drives away — for those whose rite is the five-porridge sacrifice, it is restored in full.

sanskrit: yā pūrvapatiṃ vittvā- -athānyaṃ vindate 'param | pañcaudanaṃ ca tāv ajaṃ pacato na vi yoṣataḥ ||
english: She who, having known a first husband, then finds another — those two, cooking the goat as the five-porridge offering, shall not be separated.

sanskrit: samānaloko bhavati punarbhuvāparaḥ patiḥ | ajaṃ pañcaudanaṃ dakṣiṇājyotiṣaṃ dadat ||
english: The later husband of a twice-wed woman comes to share the same world with her, giving the goat as the five-porridge offering with the southern light.

sanskrit: sūryo mā varcasokṣatu- -ukṣatām aśvinobhā | āditya ūrdhva uccaran sa u mā varcasokṣatu ||
english: May the Sun sprinkle me with radiance; may both the Aśvins sprinkle me. The Āditya rising high aloft — may he too sprinkle me with radiance.

sanskrit: varcasā māṃ pitur agnir varcasā mā bṛhaspatiḥ | surāyāḥ sicyamānāyāḥ kīlālavarcasena mā | tena mām aśvinobhā ukṣatāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: May Agni, the father's fire, anoint me with radiance; may Bṛhaspati anoint me with radiance. With the radiance of surā as it is poured, with the brilliance of sweet drink, may both the Aśvins, wreathed in lotus, sprinkle me.

sanskrit: varcasvan me mukham astu rocamānaṃ viṣāsahi | tan mā hiraṇyavarcasaṃ kṛṇomi paśyatāṃ priyam ||
english: Let my face be possessed of radiance, glowing and victorious over all. I make myself golden-bright, beloved in the sight of those who behold.

sanskrit: madhor ahaṃ madhutaro madhughān madhumattaraḥ | mām anu pra viśatu varca ṛṣabho vāśitām iva ||
english: Sweeter than sweetness am I; dripping with honey, I overflow with honey. Let radiance enter into me as a bull enters the lowing cow.

sanskrit: idam āñjanam ānaje varcasyam ā kanikradam | yathā kanikradac carāṇi varcasā ca bhagena ca ||
english: This ointment I anoint upon myself, calling aloud with radiance. So may I move about calling aloud, endowed with radiance and with good fortune.

sanskrit: varcasāgnim ā dadhati varcasod eti sūryaḥ | yāvad varco gohiraṇyasya tāvan me varco bhūyāt ||
english: With radiance they establish Agni; with radiance the Sun rises. As great as the radiance of cattle and gold — so great may my radiance become.

sanskrit: yāvat tvaṃ deva sūrya udyann abhi vipaśyasi | tāvan mā varcasābhi vi paśya ||
english: As far as you, O divine Sun, look out upon the world as you rise — look upon me with that same radiance.

sanskrit: pūrṇo bhagasyāhaṃ bhūtvā- -arukṣaṃ varcaso ratham | sa mā vahatu sarvadā- -āyuṣmantaṃ suvarcasam ||
english: Having become full of Bhaga's bounty, I have mounted the chariot of radiance. May it carry me always — long-lived and of splendid brilliance.

sanskrit: bhagenāhaṃ parihito varcasā draviṇena ca | yathā carāṇi sarvadā rocamānaṃ vibhāvasu ||
english: I am clothed about with Bhaga's bounty, with radiance, and with wealth, so that I may ever move glowing, brilliant like the sun.

sanskrit: evā mā bhaga āgamad evā mā varca āgamat | evā mā teja āgamad evā mā yaśa āgamat ||
english: Thus let Bhaga's bounty come to me; thus let radiance come to me; thus let fiery energy come to me; thus let renown come to me.

sanskrit: hiraṇyayena cakreṇa bhagasyāpihito gṛhaḥ | taṃ vy ubjāmi brahmaṇā tasya me dattam aśvinā dattaṃ me puṣkarasrajā ||
english: With a golden wheel the house of Bhaga is covered over. I open it with sacred utterance — may that be granted to me by the Aśvins, granted to me by the lotus-wreathed ones.
